overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board only asked interview candidates to wait outside voluntarily, and nobody was barred from the public meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board barred building inspector interview candidates from the meeting room until their turn to be interviewed, contrary to open-meeting access.
allegations.key_passage: In this instance, however, we find that the manner in which the Board requested - but did not direct - that the candidates remain outside the meeting room complied with the requirements of the Open Meeting Law.
